info.title: dottype
info.description: Generate minimal C# POCOs from JSON, CSV, and Parquet files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate a minimal C# POCO from a JSON, CSV, or Parquet file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write to a file instead of stdout; - means stdout

options.name: --name
options.description: Root C# type name (default: input file name)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Wrap generated types in this namespace

options.name: --format
options.description: for stdin; otherwise inferred from extension

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help
Files ending in .gz or .br are decompressed before reading their inner format.
For compressed stdin, specify both --format and --compression.
